name: University of Milan
summary: Milan's large public university (La Statale); one English bachelor's in international politics, law and economics, plus English-taught Medicine.

ib.text: A school diploma after at least 12 years, English at B2, and an admission test (IPLE: language comprehension, logic and maths; Medicine: the national test in English).

programmes.name: International Politics, Law and Economics (IPLE)
programmes.about: The University of Milan's first bachelor's taught entirely in English: international politics, law and economics combined, taught in person in central Milan.
programmes.ib: Admission test in two sessions: a spring one for students in their final school year, a summer one open to all. English B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the admission test (language comprehension, logic and maths); 125 places for EU applicants. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery – International Medical School
programmes.about: Milan's six-year medical degree taught in English; the first-year course usually begins in mid-October.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English, same day at every Italian public university with English Medicine: 60 questions on logic, biology, chemistry, physics, maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set each year by the Ministry and filled by admission test ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: IPLE's spring test session is only for students in their final school year, so sit it before your IB exams.
The English medical admission test is held in the autumn (29 September in 2026), after IB results are out.
University of Milan pages were only partly readable, so check its 'Programmes in English' page for any other English bachelor's.
